cards.title: L11 observed slice · task lifecycle inside mode31
items: Reuse the published L10 goal/mode and stock controllers. Native RUNNING→DWELLING→COMPLETE was observed with2000ms dwell at7.79s, then29.76s qualifying sampled hold. COMPLETE does not land/disarm.

Native arrival checks retained radius1m, horizontal speed≤0.3m/s, absolute-height error≤0.2m, vertical speed≤0.2m/s and bounded estimator-update gaps. API validity is used; independent per-sensor age and fault campaigns remain unqualified.

A fresh versioned USER_3 during movement selected stock BRAKE and reported ABORTED. External two-second stop completed4.11s after acknowledgment, at least3.08m short of the goal. Operator LAND/disarm ended each flight.

Duplicate start/abort requests preserved actual state without reinstalling targets or re-arming. Exact-L10 rollback returned USER_3 UNSUPPORTED. Four-file L11 publication authorized; guided checkpoint complete after clarification. Guard/fallback/interrupted branches are source-inspected, not fault-injected.

cards.title: L10 observed scope · one airborne native goal
items: Stock GUIDED performs the operator-commanded takeoff. COMMAND_INT / USER_2 explicitly requests execution of the already admitted task ID; direct mode selection has no start authorization.

SITL-only mode31 ModeFeatherLane subclasses upstream ModeGuided. Only the selected native adapter runs; inherited Guided methods set the stored destination and drive existing position/attitude controllers. Standard Guided setpoint ingress is disabled for this mode.

Entry rechecks source/ID, armed airborne GUIDED state, low speed, usable home/absolute navigation, limits and reference consistency. The destination altitude is anchored to the saved admission home, then converted using the current valid estimator reference.

The adapter cannot arm or take off. Normal mode changes relinquish execution; a reference/navigation guard requests stock LAND. This is a nominal SITL slice: L11 arrival/abort is recorded separately, and failure/hardware qualification is not claimed.

Final source: 0.99m/s peak, externally measured two-second dwell at7.93s and50.27s additional qualifying hold, then operator LAND/disarm. Exact-stock rollback observed; L10 published, guided checkpoint complete after clarification.

cards.title: L09 observed admission
items: MAVProxy sends COMMAND_INT / USER_1 (31010) into a SITL-only Copter receiver and FL_TaskAdmission. Our version1 contract validates frame, source, vehicle/navigation prerequisites and bounded task fields.
Final-source manual run: one acceptance, two duplicates and19 rejections; every later report preserved task1. All93 heartbeat samples remained disarmed, with on-ground telemetry.

Version1 is exact; minimum height1cm avoids rounding a positive request to zero. Earlier source and observations remain separate evidence. One RAM slot holds the admitted goal, limits and home reference.

No execution/arm/mode/target/motor interface was added in L09. The preserved L08 binary returned UNSUPPORTED for USER_1 and retained L08 status. L09 firmware commit 39cf614d1aae2ee4acb93f9294ebf66178967acb is published; L10 execution is recorded separately.

cards.title: L08 observed local implementation
items: FL_Status is a bounded observer, not a task coordinator or flight mode. The Copter hook copies actual mode/arming; stock GCS sends status.
Custom SITL built and reported 13 status lines in a disarmed session. Stock modes retain authority; no target or motor writes were added.
The preserved stock executable was then observed for 78 seconds of heartbeat telemetry with no FL L08 message. Both sessions were stopped disarmed/on-ground.

Only the observer/build/hook is implemented in firmware commit 3f467d90be284654c5721ac3d94c26863f771275 against Copter-4.7.2 fb773567896014da007bca58358704d4a0d8516f. Later admission/execution is recorded separately; see L08 evidence.

cards.title: BUILD inside the autopilot
items: ModeFeatherLane now implements the narrow local SITL L10 adapter. Broader FL_Mission coordination and failure campaigns remain future slices; L11 arrival/operator abort is recorded above.
Our C++ extension owns in-flight mission state, observation freshness, stop/continue policy and mission events.
The mode adapter reuses navigation/controllers. Existing arming, manual override and failsafe semantics must be qualified and retained.
Mission-selected capabilities: coordinate/route tasks need no target detector; object-dependent steps require qualified perception/localization.

cards.title: REUSE and explicit interfaces
items: Stock AUTO / AP_Mission and GUIDED remain baseline choices. Only the selected mode runs; custom behavior does not imply simultaneous AUTO execution.
L09 USER_1 and L10 USER_2 are scoped project-local contracts. Broader observation ingress remains unqualified; stock Guided setpoints are disabled for the native mode.
External perception supplies timestamped goals/estimates. No blocking inference, browser work or slow I/O belongs in critical callbacks.

cards.title: Maintenance and evidence
items: Maintain identifiable custom commits against pinned upstream/submodules. Review integrations and requalify before adopting an update.
Native placement removes a process/message boundary for internal decisions; end-to-end latency benefit remains unmeasured.
Maintained core design. Native placement is user-confirmed; broader mission design, contracts and timing budgets remain proposed. Current learning progress is recorded in the phase registry.
